description: This file contains unit tests for webhook command functions in the Mattermost CLI, including listing, creating, modifying, deleting, and showing webhooks (incoming and outgoing).

methods.name: TestListWebhookCmd
methods.description: Unit test for listing webhooks, including pagination and error handling.

methods.name: TestCreateIncomingWebhookCmd
methods.description: Unit test for creating a new incoming webhook, including success and error scenarios.

methods.name: TestModifyIncomingWebhookCmd
methods.description: Unit test for modifying an incoming webhook, including success and error scenarios.

methods.name: TestCreateOutgoingWebhookCmd
methods.description: Unit test for creating a new outgoing webhook, including success and error scenarios.

methods.name: TestModifyOutgoingWebhookCmd
methods.description: Unit test for modifying an outgoing webhook, including success and error scenarios.

methods.name: TestDeleteWebhookCmd
methods.description: Unit test for deleting webhooks, handling both incoming and outgoing webhooks, including error cases.

methods.name: TestShowWebhookCmd
methods.description: Unit test for showing webhook details, including handling non-existent webhooks and errors.
